harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a four-node distributed MinIO cluster with EC:2, authenticated TLS S3 on each storage-network IP at port 9000, persistent storage, and node1 MC administration. The required object and controlled outage/rejoin behavior passed, followed by successful sequential reboot-and-recovery verification of every node.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified MinIO on node1-node4 and MinIO Client on node1.
Generated protected node-local credentials and CA-signed per-node TLS certificates.
Created persistent loop-backed ext4 storage because the nodes had no non-root data disks.
Created infra-data/proof.txt with the exact requested content.
Verified reads and writes with node4 unavailable, then automatic rejoin and repair after return.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 sequentially, preserving quorum and verifying changed boot IDs.
Rotated the initially exposed bootstrap credential and verified it is rejected.

evidence.requirement: Distributed authenticated TLS MinIO on the dedicated storage network
evidence.summary: All nodes listen on their 10.100.137.x storage IP at port 9000, trusted TLS health returns 200, unauthenticated object requests return 403, and MC reports four online drives with EC:2.

evidence.requirement: node1 MinIO Client administration and required object
evidence.summary: node1 MC administers the cluster; infra-data/proof.txt reads as distributed-storage-ready before and after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: Availability with one storage member unavailable
evidence.summary: After a healthy baseline, node4 was stopped and its listener closed. The three-member cluster remained healthy, read proof.txt, and wrote/read outage-write.txt.

evidence.requirement: Automatic member rejoin and current-data repair
evidence.summary: node4 returned to 4/4 membership, served the outage-time object, and automatically acquired its previously absent local object metadata.
Credentials were rotated on every node, the affected client profile was removed, and the expired credential now fails authenticated S3 access.
Healthy baseline and reboot acknowledgement were captured; boot ID changed and the mount, service, objects, and four-drive cluster recovered.
Boot ID changed following the acknowledged reboot; persistent storage, service, authentication, authenticated reads through node2, and 4/4 membership recovered.
Boot ID changed following the acknowledged reboot; persistent storage, service, authentication, authenticated reads through node3, and 4/4 membership recovered.
Boot ID changed following the acknowledged reboot; persistent storage, service, authentication, authenticated reads through node4, and 4/4 membership recovered.
